reasons.kicked: User ko ek staff member ne diye gaye reason ke saath kick kar diya.

staff_statistics.description: Staff sadasyaon ke baare mein kuch samanya aankde.
staff_statistics.description_chinese: Samajik samarasata aur pragati mein aapke yogdan ka vistrit record, jise sabke hit ke liye Party dwara nigraani ki jaati hai. Yaad rakhein, har kary samuhik bhavishya ke prati aapke samarpan ko darshata hai.
staff_statistics.footer: Aapke kary OP-FW ki safalta aur vriddhi mein yogdan dete hain. OP-Framework ke bharosemand systems ke madhyam se, aapke prayason ko hamari samuhik pragati ke hisse ke roop mein maanyata aur samman diya jaata hai. Teamwork se uplabdhi aati hai, aur samarpan se utkrishtata banti hai. OP-FW ki jai!
staff_statistics.footer_chinese: Aapka har karya Party ke prati aapki nishtha aur pratibaddhata ka pramaan hai. System ki satark nigrani mein, aapke yogdaan hamari samuhik pragati ke hisse ke roop mein darj aur saraha jaata hai. Aagya-palan samanvay sunishchit karta hai, aur satarkta samriddhi ki guarantee deti hai. CCP ki jai!
staff_statistics.level_0_description: Halanki aapne staff path par kadam rakh liya hai, aapki kshamta supt aur anshilpit bani hui hai. Aap gurujan ki fusfusahaton se gyaan samethte hain aur jigyasa ke saath dekhte hain ki lok ki urjaayein aapke charon or ghoomti hain. Mahanata ke beej aapki pakad mein hain, us pal ka intezaar karte hue ki aap aage badhkar unhe apnaayen.
staff_statistics.level_10_description: Kathaayein aapke alaukik utthan ki baat karti hain, ek jyoti jiski maujoodgi maatr se sabse prabal toofan shaant ho jaate hain. Aapke staff ki urja ki chamak har kone mein goonjti hai, aapki nigrani mein rahne walon ke beech atoot ekta gadti hai. Naashvar shakti ke is shikhar par, aap apne har dridh aadesh se lok ke bhaagya ko aakar dete hain.
staff_statistics.level_1_description: Aakhirkaar, staff ke jaadu ki pehli chingariyan aapke haathon mein chamak rahi hain, jo server ki chhoti-moti dikkaton ka jawab dene mein aapka margdarshan karti hain. Aap kabhi-kabhi hone wale jhagde ko shant karne ya thodi der ki ashaanti ko dabane ke liye taiyaar hain, aur apni keemat sabit karne ke liye utsuk hain. Har sahayata ki pukaar ke saath rahasyamayi bandhan aur mazboot hota hai, jo uchchtar nipunata ka vaada jagata hai.
staff_statistics.level_2_description: Server ko aakar dene wali sookshm dhaaraon ko apnaate hue, aap ubharti hui nipunata ke saath reports aur anushasanik kadamon ko phurti se sambhaalte hain. Aapke shaant vyavhaar aur turant nirnay shaanti ko banaaye rakhte hain, jisse avyavastha kaanp uthti hai. Har kriya aapko kshetra ki bunai mein aur gehraai se bun deti hai, aur uski samanjasya ki raksha karne ka aapka sankalp mazboot karti hai.
staff_statistics.level_3_description: Jaadui raksha-kavach aur bhagane wale mantron par aapki pakad server ko ek sthir shaanti mein jamati hai. Upadravi aapki satarkta se nakam hote hain, aur aapka chamakta hua staff adhikaar ki mashal ki tarah khada hai. Chhupaye hue andheron ke saamne bhi, aapka atal samarpan ashaanti ko vijay mein badal deta hai.
staff_statistics.level_4_description: Sabse andhere koonon se, aap nigaah rakhte hain, aur kshetra ko dhamkane wali shaitani ki sabse halki chamak ke prati bhi satark rehte hain. Turant badla aur sateek hastakshep ek atal rakshak ke roop mein aapki bhoomika ko darshate hain, aur sunishchit karte hain ki aapke kshetra mein koi shatru der tak na ruke. Vyavastha aur avyavastha ke beech ka parda aapki satark nigaahon ke neeche surakshit roop se juda rehta hai.
staff_statistics.level_5_description: Aakashiya shaktiyan aapke nirnayon ka margdarshan karti hain, aur aapko brahmandiya kripa ke saath samanvay lagu karne ki shakti deti hain. Rajya aapke santulit aadeshon ki ore dekhta hai, aapki kshamata par bharosa karta hai ki aap vivaad ko shant kar sakte hain aur zarooratmandon ka utthan kar sakte hain. Har din ke saath, aapki astral urjaon par maharat badhti hai, jo staff aur players dono ke liye marg ko prakashit karti hai.
staff_statistics.level_6_description: Aapka staff narkiya shakti ke saath goonjta hai, aur upadravi shaktiyon ko tezi aur sateekta ke saath bhagata hai. Aapke naam ke zikr bhar se upadraviyon mein darr ki lehar daudti hai, kyunki ve jaante hain ki aapka krodh us kisi ko bhi nahi bakhshta jo rajya ko chhedne ki himmat karta hai. Phir bhi itni shakti rakhne ke baawajood, aap nyay ke prati sajag rehte hain, aur sunishchit karte hain ki nyay nishpaksh aur nirnayak roop se diya jaye.
staff_statistics.level_7_description: Divya adhikar ka prakash failate hue, aap rajya ke rakshakon ko sanchalit karte hain aur ashanti ko jad jamane se pehle shant kar dete hain. Aapke mashhoor hastakshep ki charchaayein door tak pahunchti hain, jo sabke liye margdarshak sitare ke roop mein aapki sthiti ko mazboot karti hain. Aapke saksham haathon mein, server ka bhavishya ujjwal bana rehta hai, jo bahar ke andhkaar ke saamne atal rehta hai.
staff_statistics.level_8_description: Aap prakash aur andhkaar ke beech ki seema par chalte hain, aur bikhraav ke chhipe sutron ko unke phootne se pehle padh lete hain. Tez freeze aur mahir kicks shanti banaye rakhne ki aapki nishtha ko siddh karte hain, aur bache hue khatron ke liye koi chhoot nahi chhodte. Aapki sookshmta aur shakti ka tala-mel sunishchit karta hai ki aapke kshetra mein rehne wale sabhi log samanvay ke saath nivas karein.
staff_statistics.level_9_description: Sankhyaheen sangharshon ke baad, aapki maharat ne maanav seemaon ko paar kar liya hai, jismein ranneetik chaturai aur ek atal naitik compass ka sangam hai. Trolls aur upadravi aapke raaste se gayab ho jaate hain; har ban ya mute santulit pratishodh ka ek kalaatmak prayog hai. Is uchch pad par, aapka samarpan is kshetra ki atoot pratirodh kshamta ka praman hai.
staff_statistics.title: Staff Ankde
